title: rehmannia glutinosa var. piasezkii
intro: Rehmannia glutinosa var. piasezkii, commonly known as Chinese foxglove root or Di Huang, is a plant species in the saxifrage family, used in traditional Chinese medicine. This plant is prized for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of anemia, fatigue, and low libido, as well as its ability to improve sleep quality and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Rehmannia glutinosa var. piasezkii are attributed to its tonifying properties, which help to nourish and balance the body's energy, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include polysaccharides, alkaloids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
